risks.risk: Brake condition and stopping power (pads/rotors/cables may be worn or misadjusted).
risks.proof: A short video of a brake test (riding slowly and braking hard) plus close-up photos of both front and rear brake parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes not confirmed (assume needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Gear shifting quality (derailleur alignment, cable stretch, worn cassette/chain).
risks.proof: Video of shifting through all gears under pedaling, plus close-up of the rear derailleur and shifter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gears not confirmed (assume may need adjustment/maintenance).

risks.risk: Tire condition (sidewall cracks, tread wear, punctures/repairs).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires (tread + sidewalls) and a photo of the inner tube/valve area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires may need replacement or repair.

risks.risk: Frame/fork alignment and hidden damage (bent wheel, fork issues, loose headset).
risks.proof: Photos of both wheels straight-on and from the side, plus a video showing the bike rolling straight and steering smoothly.

risks.risk: Missing accessories despite claim (lights, pump, lock, tools, reflectors, etc.).
risks.proof: A photo spread showing every accessory included laid out, with a checklist.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as bicycle only (no accessories included).

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the drivetrain: rear derailleur, shifter, cassette/chain area.
Close-up photos of brakes: front and rear brake components (pads/rotors/calipers) and cable condition.
Short videos: (1) shifting through all gears while pedaling, (2) braking test front and rear.
Close-up photos of both tires (tread + sidewalls) and wheel condition (straightness).
Photos of all claimed accessories laid out (and confirm what is included).
If possible, a receipt or date proof for the “6 months” claim.
response.reason: The photo confirms a fat-tire bicycle, but key value drivers from the seller’s claims (gear/brake performance, rust-free status, originality, and included accessories) are not verifiable from the single wide shot. Request the specific close-ups and test videos before pricing.
